virals_narrative: First scan: Seedance 2.5 + Magnific prompt-share clips dominate the AI VFX niche; 'prompts below' CTAs and before/after edits pull the biggest views.
narrative_synthesis: First scan: Seedance 2.5 + Magnific prompt-share clips dominate the AI VFX niche; 'prompts below' CTAs and before/after edits pull the biggest views.

drafts.draft_en: Paid for a normal shot, got a whole world. One first frame locked in Magnific, then Seedance 2.5 does the camera move. Full prompts below 👇
drafts.video_tip: 8-10s reveal: static locked first frame, then a slow push-in into a fantasy VFX environment; end on a surprise detail. Prompts in the first reply.

drafts.draft_en: I make it look better: same clip, before vs after AI VFX. Raw phone footage in, cinematic grade + set extension out. Free prompt in the replies.
drafts.video_tip: Split-screen or hard-cut before/after, raw footage 2s then the VFX version; keep it under 15s, loop-friendly.

drafts.draft_en: Seedance 2.5 vs Kling vs Wan on the exact same prompt. Same first frame, same motion brief. Which one would you ship? 👇
drafts.video_tip: 3-panel grid with model labels, identical 5s shot (e.g. Marseille harbour turning into a sci-fi port); ask viewers to vote.

drafts.draft_en: AI video is basically solved for social. The hard part now is taste: framing, timing, the one detail people rewatch. Here is my Lumen Velar workflow, step by step 👇
drafts.video_tip: Opinion hook over a polished 10s clip, then a thread of 4 frames showing each workflow step (character sheet, first frame, motion, grade).

drafts.draft_en: Marseille, but make it a blockbuster. One street, five cinematic universes. Which version are you living in? 👀 Prompts below 👇
drafts.video_tip: Fast-cut montage of the same local shot restyled 5 ways (noir, cyberpunk, fantasy, western, anime), ~1.5s each, beat-synced.
